main_text.head: XIV. RESPONSUM DANIÆ REGIS ad LEGATUM.
main_text.p: Fredericus II. Dei Gratia Daniæ, Norvegiæ, Vandalorum, Gotthorum Rex. Dux Slesvici, Holsatiæ, Stormariæ, ac Ditmarsiæ. Comes in Oldenburgh & Delmenhorst, Salutem cum favore nostro.

p.i: Generose nobis sincere ac imprimis dilecte.

main_text.p: INtelleximus ex literis Synceritatis tuæ, Legationem suam apud non-nul[?]

page.notes: The last line is set in large initial letters and partly overprinted by a stamp-like mark; "Syncerit" and "nul" are uncertain. The line ending "E . nul" in the scan is not fully legible; the remaining letters are illegible, ~6 letters. The running head is set in italic with mixed type.
